text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is in the middle of an online
match in
her usual game.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Auto-aim, no collision... Looks like a new

cheating tool is making the rounds
again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, screw this. There's no way to play
until they
get it sorted out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What a waste of time. I'm goin' to bed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just because they're cheating, it doesn't
mean they've gotten any smarter. If I just
use the terrain
to my advantage and set
a trap for them...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, if anything, this has made my mind
sharper. Just like in programming, you're
free to use whatever means you can to
achieve your goal. There are plenty of
ways to go about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Air Shakur is honing her strategic
planning
skills, she also has plenty of
ideas that can be put
to use in her races.
